title: 0xR Wallet
tagline: Wallet to onboard Web2 users to Web3 by offering a smooth crypto on-ramp experience.
description: This is an embryo of the next-generation crypto wallet with a user friendly crypto on-ramp process via Unlimit. The long-term goal of this project is to implement account abstraction and social recovery as well as cross-chain transactions. Making it easy for Web2 users to get in to Web3.
how_its_made:
The app is build with React Native and will be deployed on iOS and Android. I'm using Unlimit for fiat on-ramp and alchemy SDK to fetch token balances. I hoped to use Biconemy for account abstraction.

Unfortunately the time wasn't enough to start with account abstraction and cross-chain transactions but I will finalize this project after the hack.
